title: Cloud Storage, Object Lifecycle, and Enterprise File Systems — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates accidental bucket deletion and ransomware attempt: demonstrates Bucket Lock and Object Versioning preventing unauthorized data destruction.
routing_rationale: Object Retention Lock enforces immutable WORM (Write Once, Read Many) compliance, ensuring objects cannot be deleted or overwritten even by project owners.

nodes.label: Compromised Admin Key
nodes.detail: Executes gsutil rm -r -f gs://brightloaf-ledger to destroy corporate books.

nodes.label: Cloud Audit Security Alert
nodes.detail: Logs attempted deletion with principal identity and source IP address.

nodes.label: Bucket Lock (WORM Shield)
nodes.detail: Strictly rejects object deletion attempts until expiration timestamp.

nodes.label: Object Versioning Vault
nodes.detail: Preserves immutable historical generations even if live object is overwritten.

steps.title: Destruction Attempt
steps.action: Compromised admin attempts to delete accounting records.
steps.why_traversal: Security controls must withstand compromised credentials.

steps.title: WORM Enforcement
steps.action: Bucket Lock intercepts command; responds HTTP 403 Retention policy prevents deletion.
steps.why_traversal: Cryptographic WORM policy cannot be bypassed by project owners or Google support.

steps.title: Version Preservation
steps.action: Object versioning keeps non-current generation intact; data recovery takes seconds.
steps.why_traversal: Zero data loss achieved even under full root account takeover.

scenarios.label: Lifecycle Rule Overriding Versioning
scenarios.root_cause: Misconfigured lifecycle rule set DeleteNoncurrentVersion after 1 day.
scenarios.diverted_path: Non-current generations purged automatically by lifecycle manager.
scenarios.blast_radius: Historical versions lost before human recovery could occur.
scenarios.recovery: Increase noncurrentDaysRetention to minimum 30 days on compliance buckets.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
